newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RTRS-Plessey sets new foreign earnings goal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Plessey sets new foreign earnings goal.

text.p: South Africa's Plessey Corp Ltd said on Friday that a recent deal to buy the traffic systems, aerospace and communications units of Australia's AWA Ltd will allow it to set a new foreign earnings target.

"We will now easily achieve our goal of 30 percent of earnings being derived from foreign currencies and have set a new target of 50 percent by the year 2000 or sooner," the electronics group's chief executive John Temple said in a statement.

The deal was announced on December 24 and the new businesses are to be held together in a newly created firm called Plessey Asia Pacific (Pty) Ltd. The price tag for the operations was A$17.5 million.
Plessey will hold 74 percent of the new firm and the remaining 26 percent will be owned by RMB Australia, a unit of Rand Merchant Bank.
Temple said the deal had synergistic beenfits, increased exports, rationalised research and development costs and provided hedging oportunites against the weak rand.
It was also a chance to supply infrastructure products to the rapidly expanding markets of South-East Asia.
